154:t_004:14.en:
$$連邦兵$$
「$$ＧＮ－Ｘ$$ squad, secure the Chief Representative's residence. We'll handle the two units that didn't retreat.」

154:t_004:15.en:
$$連邦兵$$
「We've been told we needn't worry about damage to the surrounding area. Go all out.」

154:t_005:0.en:
$$リディ$$
「Come on, you lapdogs of the powerful! Don't think you're getting past here!」

154:t_005:1.en:
$$リディ$$
「$$ミネバ$$! I'll protect you, no matter what!」

154:t_006:0.en:
$$リディ$$
($$ミネバ$$... I can't leave you under Dad's control anymore...)

154:t_006:1.en:
$$リディ$$
(When this battle is over, you and I will...)

154:t_007:0.en:
$$カガリ$$
「All right...! You did well, $$キラ$$!」

154:t_008:0.en:
$$キラ$$
「$$カガリ$$...! Hurry the islanders' evacuation while we have the chance!」

154:t_008:2.en:
$$リディ$$
「The enemy's main force is coming!」

154:t_009:0.en:
$$キラ$$
「Their numbers are different this time...!」

154:t_009:1.en:
$$リディ$$
「They even have units from $$マリーメイア$$'s army...!」

154:t_009:2.en:
$$カガリ$$
「Princess $$マリナ$$, Vice Minister $$リリーナ$$, Vice Minister $$ナナリー$$! Please escape!」

154:t_009:3.en:
$$キサカ$$
「You can't, Representative! If you try to leave the island now, you'll just be picked off!」

154:t_009:4.en:
$$カガリ$$
「Ghh...! The island is completely surrounded!」

154:t_010:0.en:
$$リディ$$
「Every last one of them...! They're getting in the way of me and $$ミネバ$$!」

154:t_011:0.en:
$$キラ$$
「Please calm down! Fighting blindly won't change the situation!」

154:t_011:1.en:
$$リディ$$
「Then what else can we do! If there's anything, tell me, $$キラ$$!」

154:t_011:3.en:
$$キラ$$
「But if we die, we won't be able to do anything!」

154:t_012:0.en:
$$キラ$$
「I'll cover you. Please focus on the enemies ahead, Ensign.」

154:t_012:2.en:
$$キラ$$
「I've always had someone watching my back like this, too.」

154:t_014:1.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「$$キラ$$, Ensign $$リディ$$! We'll support you!」

154:t_014:2.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Ensign $$リディ$$! Is $$オードリー$$ in $$オーブ$$ too!」

154:t_014:3.en:
$$リディ$$
「I'm under no obligation to answer that.」

154:t_014:6.en:
$$カツ$$
「Ensign $$リディ$$ has been strangely harsh with $$バナージ$$ since around the end of the $$時獄戦役$$.」

154:t_014:7.en:
$$ファ$$
「It seems a little different from rivalry, though...」

154:t_014:8.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Save personal matters for later. Don't forget that $$オーブ$$ now holds people essential to shaping the world's future.」

154:t_014:10.en:
$$刹那$$
($$マリナ・イスマイール$$... You're here too...)

154:t_014:11.en:
$$ゼロ$$
($$ナナリー$$... I'll protect the world you love.)

154:t_014:12.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「All units, intercept the $$連邦軍$$! You're all right with that too, Captain $$オットー$$?」

154:t_014:13.en:
$$オットー$$
「Of course! Those people have broken away from the chain of command. They're effectively a private army!」

154:t_014:14.en:
$$オットー$$
「As the independent unit $$ロンド・ベル$$, we cannot leave people like that unchecked!」

154:t_014:15.en:
$$レイアム$$
「Captain...! I've confirmed a unit approaching this area at high speed!」

154:t_015:1.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「Is it the same model as $$バナージ$$'s $$ユニコーン$$!」

154:t_015:4.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「Black... It's also the color of a strong will that no one can violate.」

154:t_015:5.en:
$$カレン$$
「If someone like that is coming, we won't hold back either!」

154:t_015:6.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「I judge that black $$ユニコーン$$ to be the core of the enemy's fighting force! Bringing it down will decide this battle!」

154:t_015:8.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「Do you feel it too, $$バナージ$$?」

154:t_015:9.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Yes... Something coming from that machine... is resonating in my heart...!」

154:t_015:10.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「Let's find out what it is...!」

154:t_015:13.en:
$$アムロ$$
「All units, begin the attack! Leave the black $$ユニコーン$$ to $$バナージ$$ and $$カミーユ$$!」

154:t_015:14.en:
$$プルトゥエルブ$$
「$$ガンダム$$... That is... the enemy of my master and me...」

154:t_016:0.en:
$$プルトゥエルブ$$
「Ghh...! Hasn't the $$バンシィ$$ adapted to me yet!」

154:t_018:0.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Stop, $$マリーダ$$! You mustn't do this!」

154:t_018:1.en:
$$プルトゥエルブ$$
「Shut up, $$ガンダム$$! I am... $$プルトゥエルブ$$!!」

154:t_019:0.en:
$$プルトゥエルブ$$
「Ghh...! Hasn't the $$バンシィ$$ adapted to me yet!」

154:t_021:0.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Stop, $$マリーダ$$! You mustn't do this!」

154:t_021:1.en:
$$プルトゥエルブ$$
「Shut up, $$ガンダム$$! I am... $$プルトゥエルブ$$!!」

154:t_023:0.en:
$$プルトゥエルブ$$
「Ghh...! Hasn't the $$バンシィ$$ adapted to me yet!」
